name: Tsuma ga Shounen-tachi ni Choukyou Sareteiru You Desu
original_name: 妻が少年達に調教されているようです
source:
Pitiful businessman Yoshio loves his wife while she loves being dominated by young men.
They photograph her and have sex with her in real time via video email.
